create_MLEBenchTask: create an MLEBenchTask instance with an MLEBenchTaskConfig to set up a machine learning benchmark task
prepare_MLEBenchTask: prepare an MLEBenchTask by initializing the submission file path and task description for the solver interpreter
step_task_MLEBenchTask: execute a single step of an MLEBenchTask by running solution code and evaluating the generated submission CSV
evaluate_fitness_MLEBenchTask: evaluate the fitness of a final solution by running it and scoring the submission against competition metrics
parse_report_MLEBenchTask: parse an evaluation report dictionary converting numeric values to floats for consistent scoring output
